name: dogfood-security-supply-chain-slsa-app
description: Dogfood app v1.39-4 — an in-toto + sigstore + cosign style supply chain security orchestrator (SLSA level 0-4 gate + reproducible build hash matching + signed provenance with builder + material set + attestation policy verification with trust root fingerprint + fused SLSA-to-attestation policy pipeline) that drives a supply chain security surface backed by @kiwa-lab/security v0.2 supply-chain semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_COSIGN_BIN + KIWA_IN_TOTO_URL + KIWA_REKOR_URL + KIWA_COSIGN_TRUST_ROOT provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.
